summary.intent: Resolve all open PR review comments on PR #296 (SDK extraction) and fix a recurring E2E test failure caused by Zustand store access not being available in production CI builds.
summary.outcome: All review threads across multiple review rounds were resolved with code fixes. The E2E infrastructure was refactored to use UI-based state detection and a minimal `window.__E2E` helper gated behind `VITE_E2E=true`, replacing direct Zustand store exposure. A separate PR (#303) was needed after the fix was accidentally committed to an already-merged branch.

repo: cipher-box uses pnpm workspaces with packages: crypto, core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk, and apps: web, api, desktop
CI workflows (e2e.yml, deploy-staging.yml, e2e-desktop.yml) only built @cipherbox/crypto before @cipherbox/web — missing core, api-client, sdk-core, sdk after PR #296 added them
__ZUSTAND_STORES was only exposed under import.meta.env.DEV, making all Zustand-dependent E2E tests silently fail in CI production builds
release-please with multi-component manifest uses the target branch name ('main') in PR titles when pull-request-title-pattern contains ${version} — there's no single version to show
The first release-please PR bumps all packages together since one PR (#296) touched all packages; versions diverge naturally in subsequent PRs
FolderTree.clear() zeroes all stored key buffers — registerFolder storing caller-owned buffers means destroy() can zero the caller's keys
The ensureFolderRegistered isLoaded guard caused uploads to fail because SDK-created folders and root folder may have valid keys but isLoaded=false in some code paths
addInitScript and exposeFunction survive page.reload() in Playwright — the mock wallet is re-injected automatically
Core Kit session restore after reload relies on localStorage DKG shares + wallet connection to call exportTssKey against Sapphire Devnet — slow on CI
Public keys are visible in the UI at SettingsPage under .settings-pubkey-value, making Zustand store access unnecessary for sharing tests

code.finding: Dynamic import().then() for vault store caused race condition — __E2E was not set by the time conflict-detection beforeAll ran page.evaluate(). Must use static import.
ensureFolderRegistered guard using isLoaded was too strict — should only check for empty key material, not isLoaded flag
waitForFunction polling window.__ZUSTAND_STORES.vault for rootFolderKey is redundant — the file list appearing on the next wait already proves vault loaded
Test 3.7 timeout 240s was insufficient — cumulative waits (auth restore 120s + vault 60s + root sync 120s + file 30s) total ~330s worst case; bumped to 360s
Test 3.8 timeout 120s too tight for two navigateIntoFolder retries plus two 60s content waits; bumped to 240s
fileKey not cleared if exception occurs before re-wrap try/catch — needed try/finally with clearBytes()
createFolder leaked plaintext folderKey and ipnsPrivateKey on failure — needed try/catch with clearBytes before throwing
registerFolder stored caller-owned key buffers directly; destroy() calls FolderTree.clear() which zeroes them — needs defensive copies
requestAnimationFrame ID was inside async IIFE — needed to hoist focusRaf to effect scope for cancelAnimationFrame in cleanup
context.close() in catch block can mask original error — use .catch(() => undefined) on cleanup calls

workflow: Always check whether a PR has already been merged before committing fixes — happened twice in this session, requiring new branches each time
VITE_* env vars are baked into Vite builds at compile time and tree-shaken out when not set — safe pattern for E2E-only instrumentation without production exposure
Use VITE_E2E=true in CI workflow rather than exposing debug globals unconditionally in production builds
Minimize window.__E2E surface area — expose only specific getter functions for values tests need, not full store references
orval-generated API client types can be wrong (nullable Date → {[key: string]: unknown} | null) — regenerating produces the same output, it's an upstream codegen bug
GraphQL reviewThreads query is the correct way to fetch PR review threads with resolution status — REST API doesn't expose isResolved
Playwright page.evaluate() from the browser context includes cookies automatically — can make authenticated API calls without needing raw access tokens

friction: Fix for already-merged PR #296 was committed to the old branch twice — required creating new branches fix/ci-package-build-order and later fix/e2e-zustand-race each time
ZUSTAND_STORES was only exposed in DEV mode, causing silent E2E failures in CI that looked like flaky tests (3.7 reload, then conflict-detection) rather than a configuration error
Copilot review comment about ensureFolderRegistered isLoaded guard introduced a regression that caused uploads to fail with 'Folder not loaded' — the guard was too strict
Test 3.7 serial failure masked all subsequent E2E tests (36+ skipped) making it unclear which other tests were also broken
Dynamic import().then() race condition for vault store in main.tsx caused __E2E to be undefined when conflict-detection tests ran — required switching to static import
Outside-diff-range review comments (not attached to unresolved threads) required fetching review body separately via REST API
open_items: Concurrent mutations to same folder (Thread 2, first review round) acknowledged as architectural concern — UI-level serialization handles it for now but a proper fix is a follow-up
orval generated type VaultResponseDtoInitializedAt is incorrect (should be string | null, not {[key: string]: unknown} | null) — upstream orval bug, no fix available by regenerating
web3auth-helpers.ts still uses __ZUSTAND_STORES for legacy email-based test flow — only matters if TEST_LOGIN_SECRET is set, but the dead code remains
Sapphire Devnet latency causes intermittent Core Kit session restore failures in test 3.7 on CI — no root cause fix, currently treated as acceptable flakiness
